name: Castorcito
description: Build and reuse configurable UI components (banners, cards, tabs, accordions, galleries) stored in a JSON field and rendered through Single Directory Components.
project_description: Castorcito lets site builders assemble reusable, configurable UI components through an administrative interface, without writing code. Each component is a `castorcito_component` config entity built from typed "cfields" (plain/formatted text, image, link, boolean, number, list, iframe/video, entity reference, block reference, and layout containers). A component's authored values are stored in a Drupal JSON field on any content entity via the Castorcito Component widget, and rendered on display via the Castorcito Component formatter, which delegates markup to a Single Directory Component (SDC) that can be overridden from a theme. Castorcito ships five sub-modules: castorcito_basepack (ready-made components such as banner, card, tabs, accordion, carousel, gallery, quote, video), castorcito_advancedpack (advanced components such as a Swiper slider and timeline), castorcito_date (a date cfield), castorcito_webform (a cfield that embeds a Webform), and castorcito_sync (export/import of component configuration as a tarball). The module also exposes two REST resources used by its Vue-based widget: an AJAX image upload endpoint and a block-list endpoint.
